Item code of the picked item. Links to OITM.ItemCode in SAP B1. Auto-populated from required items and should not be modified. Read-only field that identifies the specific item being picked.
License plate item code key - unique identifier for license plate item management. Used in warehouse operations for tracking items with license plates. Editable field for license plate scenarios.
Item revision code for engineering change control. Links to item master revision management. Editable field for specifying which revision of the item is being picked.
Receipt status flag (Y/N) indicating if this item has already been receipted. Auto-maintained by system and should not be modified. Read-only field for tracking receipt completion.
System serial number - internal unique identifier for serial number tracking. Auto-generated by SAP B1 serial number management. Read-only field maintained by system.
Distribution serial number - internal serial number for item tracking. System-maintained serial number for distribution. Read-only field for serial number identification.
Manufacturer serial number - external serial number assigned by manufacturer. User-editable field for tracking manufacturer's original serial numbers on serialized items.
Serial number lot/batch reference - batch identifier associated with serial number. Links serial numbers to batch information. Read-only field for batch-serial correlation.
License plate code for warehouse license plate management. Used in advanced warehouse operations for tracking items by license plates. Read-only field populated by system.
License plate path - currently not used. Reserved for future license plate location tracking functionality. Read-only field not currently utilized.
Batch distribution number - internal batch number for item tracking. System-maintained batch identifier for distribution. Read-only field for batch identification.
Picked quantity for this item. Must be positive value and within available stock limits. Auto-populated but may be editable for quantity adjustments during picking process.
Batch attribute 1 - manufacturer serial for batch items. Custom batch attribute for additional manufacturer tracking. Editable field for batch-specific manufacturer information.
Batch attribute 2 - lot number for batch items. Custom batch attribute for lot tracking. Editable field for batch-specific lot identification.
Batch receipt date - when batch was received into inventory. Auto-populated with receipt date. May be editable for batch date management.
Batch manufacturing date - when batch was produced/manufactured. Important for shelf life calculations. Editable field for accurate batch lifecycle tracking.
Batch expiry date - when batch expires and should not be used. Critical for quality control and FIFO/FEFO logic. Editable field for batch lifecycle management.
Batch expiry time - specific time when batch expires (if time-sensitive). Used for precise expiry tracking. Editable field for time-critical batches.
Batch warning expiry date - early warning date before actual expiry. Used for alerts and planning. Editable field for proactive batch management.
Batch consume date - recommended consumption date for optimal quality. Used for inventory rotation planning. Editable field for batch consumption scheduling.
Batch warning consume date - early warning for consumption date. Used for proactive inventory management alerts. Editable field for consumption planning.
Batch inspection date - when batch was last inspected for quality. Used in quality control workflows. Editable field for inspection scheduling.
Batch last inspection date - most recent completed inspection date. Historical tracking for quality control. Read-only field maintained by inspection processes.
Batch next inspection date - scheduled date for next quality inspection. Used for inspection planning and alerts. Editable field for inspection scheduling.
Batch status - current lifecycle status of the batch (Available, Quarantine, etc.). Controls batch availability for picking. Editable field for batch status management.
Quality control status - current QC status of the batch (Approved, Rejected, Pending). Controls batch release for production. Editable field for QC workflow.
Batch notes - free text comments about the batch. Used for additional batch information and special handling instructions. Editable field for batch documentation.
Supplier number - vendor/supplier identifier for the batch. Links to supplier master data for traceability. Editable field for supplier tracking.
Remarks - additional comments about the picked item. Free text field for special instructions or notes. Editable field for pick-specific information.
Best before date - recommended usage date for optimal quality. Different from expiry date, used for quality guidance. Editable field for quality management.
Origin - geographical or facility origin of the item/batch. Used for traceability and compliance tracking. Editable field for origin documentation.
Location - specific location or area where item is stored/picked. Used for warehouse location tracking. Editable field for location management.
Bin allocations of pick receipt (Table: CT_PF_PRE4)
Bin absolute entry - unique identifier for warehouse bin/location. Links to OBIN.AbsEntry in SAP B1. Required field that specifies the exact bin where picked items are allocated.

Allocated quantity in this specific bin. Must be positive value. Total of all bin allocations should match the parent picked item quantity. Editable field for specifying how much quantity is allocated to this bin.
Bin code (read-only) - warehouse bin/location code. Retrieved from OBIN.BinCode based on U_BinAbsEntry. Display field showing the bin code for user reference.
